beacon_failure: wait and retry same round indefinitely; never change random source or draw twice
claims: two initial winners; private mainland China shipping, free postage; each notice starts 7 days; at deadline or later unsubmitted slot passes to first unused rank; account at most one badge; submitted before deadline reserves slot; exhausted reserve leaves slot unawarded
encoding: UTF-8 ASCII-only JSON; sorted keys, no whitespace, no trailing newline; no floats
insufficient: fewer than 2 entrants => cancel and refund everyone once; do not extend
order: seed=SHA256(ASCII(radar-sweep-v1) || 00 || U32BE(len(id)) || ASCII(id) || raw32(seal_sha256) || raw32(randomness)); key(ticket)=SHA256(seed || U32BE(len(ticket)) || ASCII(ticket)); ascending raw key, then ASCII ticket
privacy: public anonymous tickets only; address encrypted and restricted to fulfillment allowlist; delete shipping data 30 days after shipment; never put PII in notifications or logs
publication: complete manifest in public GitHub issue comment, exact created_at=updated_at strictly before scheduled beacon time; server-observed confirmation also before beacon time; comment body includes exact canonical bytes; public download required before witness
round_selection: first quicknet round at or after closes_at+600 seconds; never change chain or round
seal_failure: no timely externally witnessed seal => cancel and refund 50 once to each entrant; no late seal or redraw
speed: last full global tok/s frame published strictly before cutoff; published_at and source_at preserved; no sample => explicit missing, never zero; no later frame substituted
tickets: R plus 12 uppercase cryptographically random hex digits; one per account
